svg.title: Read Replicas
svg.desc: Read Replicas. Send writes to the primary and spread reads across asynchronously updated replicas. Step 1, Split reads from writes: Writes go to the primary; reads are spread over replicas that replay its log a moment later. Step 2, Replication lag: A user upgrades to Pro and reloads at once: replica 2 has not replayed it yet and answers Free. Step 3, Read your own writes: The fix: that user's next read carries position 43 and is held until the replica has replayed it. Step 4, Lagging or failed replicas: A long report stalls replica 3 past the lag limit and replica 1 fails: both leave the rotation.

g.text: Writes go to the primary; reads are spread over replicas that replay its log a moment later.
A user upgrades to Pro and reloads at once: replica 2 has not replayed it yet and answers Free.
The fix: that user's next read carries position 43 and is held until the replica has replayed it.
A long report stalls replica 3 past the lag limit and replica 1 fails: both leave the rotation.
or: this read goes to the primary
the only node that takes writes
transaction log · PostgreSQL WAL, MySQL binary log
Every node has the same schema and data. Only the primary takes writes.
